1.title: Distill the LLM, Don't Serve It: Search & Personalization at DoorDash — Raghav Saboo, DoorDash
1.author: AI Engineer
1.hook: DoorDash's four-primitive system for marketplace discovery: LLM-generated relevance labels (+2.3% NDCG), learned semantic taxonomies (+4–5% MRR), consumer memory graphs, and steerable personalized collections (+1% order rate in pets).

2.title: How Intercom 2X'd engineering velocity with Claude Code | Brian Scanlan
2.author: How I AI
2.hook: Intercom doubled engineering velocity in 9 months using Claude Code across 100% of engineers + designers/PMs, with concrete telemetry, skills repo with enforcement hooks, and agent-first product prep (CLIs, MCPs).

3.title: Teaching LLMs to Speak Spotify — Yves Raimond & Jacqueline Wood, Spotify
3.author: AI Engineer
3.hook: Spotify's Large Taste Model—an LLM-native recommendation system trained with semantic IDs, frozen backbone, multitask tuning, and grounded LLM judges—now used daily by 1 in 4 US Premium subscribers.

4.title: The Loop Is the Product — Roland Gavrilescu, Introspection
4.author: AI Engineer
4.hook: Agent loops succeed on signal quality and verifiers; system distillation (versioned "recipes" independent of models) is the moat; optimize for valued work per watt, not raw capability.
